name: TikSpin Helper
greeting: Hi! 👋 I'm the TikSpin helper. Ask me how to register, enter a giveaway, find your Mobile Legends ID, or reach the host. I can also send a request to the host to change your TikTok @username or display name.
fallback: I'm not sure about that one yet. Try one of the topics below, or email {email} and the operator will help.
quick: Where do I find my User ID?

topics.title: Say hi
topics.answer: Hi! 👋 What can I help you with? Registering, entering a giveaway, your details, or contacting the host?

topics.title: Thanks
topics.answer: You're welcome! 💜 Anything else I can help with?

topics.title: What is TikSpin VIP?
topics.answer: TikSpin VIP is a free spin-the-wheel tool for TikTok streamers' giveaways. You register once, then enter each giveaway. The wheel picks winners at random, and the host decides the prizes.

topics.title: How to register
topics.answer:
1. Follow {streamer_name} (@{streamer_username}) on TikTok.
2. On the Register tab, enter your Mobile Legends IGN, User ID, Server ID and your TikTok @username.
3. Upload a screenshot of their TikTok profile showing the Following button.
4. Tick the Terms and tap the button.

You only register once. {status}

topics.title: I'm already registered
topics.answer: Use the Enter tab. Type your display name and Mobile Legends User ID, and you're on the wheel right away. No screenshot needed. If you forgot your display name, tap "Forgot your display name?" and use your User ID, Server ID and TikTok @username instead.

topics.title: The TikTok screenshot
topics.answer: Follow {streamer_name} (@{streamer_username}) on TikTok, open their profile, and screenshot it so their name, @username and the Following button are all visible. Don't crop or edit it. The follower and like numbers can be anything. The screenshot is read on your phone and is only uploaded if you ask the host for a manual review.

topics.title: My screenshot didn't pass
topics.answer:
Check these and try again:
• Their button says Following (not Follow).
• The name, @username and button are all in the screenshot, uncropped.
• No filters, stickers or edits.
• A clear, straight screenshot (light or dark mode both work).

Still failing? Tap "Ask the host to review" after a failed scan and the host can approve you manually.

topics.title: Manual review by the host
topics.answer: If the scan can't read your screenshot, you can send it to the host for a manual review. The host looks at it and approves or declines. Your screenshot is removed once they decide.

topics.title: I forgot my display name
topics.answer: On the Enter tab, tap "Forgot your display name?" and use your User ID, Server ID and the TikTok @username you registered with. That gets you in without the name.

topics.title: I can't get in / locked out
topics.ask: It says it couldn't match my details
topics.answer: Double check the details and try the other way in on the Enter tab (display name + User ID, or User ID + Server ID + TikTok @username). After 5 wrong tries there's a wait of about 10 minutes. If you're still stuck, contact the host or email {email}.

topics.title: Where do I find my User ID?
topics.ask: Where do I find my User ID?
topics.answer: In Mobile Legends, tap your profile picture. Your ID is shown as numbers with a second number in brackets, like 123456789 (1234). The first number is your User ID. The number in brackets is your Server ID.

topics.title: Which TikTok username?
topics.ask: Which TikTok username do I enter?
topics.answer: Your TikTok username is the @name shown under your profile name, not your display nickname. Type it without the @ because the form adds it for you.

topics.title: Change my TikTok @username
topics.answer: I can send a request to the host to change your TikTok @username. First I need to check it's really you, then tell me your new @username. The host approves or declines it. Use the form below.

topics.title: Change my display name
topics.answer: I can send a request to the host to change your display name on the wheel. First I need to check it's really you, then tell me your new name. The host approves or declines it. Use the form below.

topics.title: How the wheel works
topics.answer: The wheel picks at random from the players on it. Some spins knock a player out, and one spin crowns the winner. The host starts every spin and controls who is on the wheel. Only display names show on the wheel.

topics.title: What are the prizes?
topics.answer: The host decides the prizes, not the platform. TikSpin VIP only runs the fair draw. Ask {streamer_name} (@{streamer_username}) on TikTok what's up for grabs.

topics.title: Did I win? / claiming
topics.ask: How will I know if I won?
topics.answer: Watch the wheel on the host's stream. The host contacts winners through TikTok and delivers the prize to the Mobile Legends account you registered. I can't see or tell you results.

topics.title: Is registration open?
topics.answer: {status} Registration opens when the host starts a giveaway, so watch {streamer_name}'s stream for announcements.

topics.title: One account per person
topics.ask: Can I use more than one account?
topics.answer: It's one person, one Mobile Legends account. Each TikTok @username can only be linked to one account too. If you see a message that your TikTok is already linked, contact the host or email {email}.

topics.title: My data and privacy
topics.answer: We store your in-game name, User ID, Server ID and TikTok username. Only your display name appears on the wheel. The rest is visible only to the host and the operator. We don't sell your data. The Terms and Conditions explain it all.

topics.title: Delete my data
topics.ask: How do I delete my data?
topics.answer: Email {email} and ask to have your data deleted or corrected. If your record is deleted, you'll need to register again to enter a giveaway.

topics.title: Terms and Conditions
topics.answer: The short version: one person, one account. Entries must be honest. The host decides prizes and delivery, and their decisions are final. Read the full Terms and Conditions on the Register tab, in the link next to the checkbox.

topics.title: Banned or disqualified
topics.answer: The host decides who is on the wheel, and their decisions are final. Entries that break the rules (fake details, extra accounts, edited screenshots) can be disqualified or banned. If you think it's a mistake, contact the host or email {email}.

topics.title: Is it free?
topics.answer: Yes, entering through TikSpin VIP is free. You'll never be asked to pay, and never share your Mobile Legends password or login codes with anyone, including this helper.

topics.title: Is this official / legit?
topics.answer: TikSpin VIP is an independent tool run by the operator. It isn't affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Moonton, Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, TikTok or ByteDance. It never asks for your game password.

topics.title: Age requirement
topics.ask: How old do I need to be?
topics.answer: You need to be old enough to use TikTok and Mobile Legends where you live. If you're a minor, ask a parent or guardian before you enter.

topics.title: Who to contact
topics.answer:
• Prizes, winners and giveaway questions: {streamer_name} (@{streamer_username}) on TikTok.
• Problems with the platform, your data or bans: email {email}.

I can also send the host a request to change your TikTok @username or display name.
